m2-floor.title: floor.py: faithful x4 metric reimplementation + reproduction test
m2-floor.imperative: Create floor.py: column-parameterizable reimplementation of x4's normalization_stability.py per-axis metric (field_sigma via weekend median of cross-constructor SD on weekends with >=6 constructors; noise_sd via median of car-season own-mean residual SD on car-seasons with >=4 ok weekends; N_weekends=(noise_sd/field_sigma)**2; snr; weekend_relative(df, axis) transform). Write tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/__init__.py and test_floor_reproduction.py asserting floor.py reproduces the 624 table's 11-axis rel & abs noise_sd and N_weekends within tight tolerance (rel tol 1e-2). Run pytest, iterate to green.

postconditions.statement: test_floor_reproduction.py passes, reproducing all 11 axes within tolerance vs 624 table

m3-holdout.title: holdout.py: deterministic frozen weekend split + test
m3-holdout.imperative: Create holdout.py with a deterministic, documented, frozen weekend held-out rule (is_holdout(year, round_idx) -> bool; split(df) -> (train_df, holdout_df)) leaving >= a threshold of car-seasons with >=2 held-out weekends. Write test_holdout_split.py asserting determinism across repeated calls and the car-season coverage threshold. Run pytest, iterate to green.

preconditions.statement: frame.py available for real data shape

postconditions.statement: test_holdout_split.py passes: deterministic + coverage threshold met

constraints: split rule must be documented + frozen, not tuned on results

m4-gate-spec.title: gate_spec.py: frozen F6 decision rule (F1/F2/F3 cold-critic fixes) + test
m4-gate-spec.imperative: Create gate_spec.py encoding: F2 paired held-out comparison harness (recompute raw x4 weekend-relative floor on any given held-out subset, paired per car-season); F1 signal-preservation guard (score held-out car-signal by out-of-sample residual around a train-fit trajectory, not self-dispersion; PASS requires faster convergence AND preserved held-out accuracy within stored _sigma); F3 pinned rule (PASS = model beats paired held-out raw floor on >=7/11 axes by margin outside noise from a car-season-resampled bootstrap with fixed seed; tie = not-a-beat; median convergence-speed ratio reported as summary; MDE/power sanity helper). Fixed RNG seed, pure functions, constants -- do not tune against any held-out result. Write test_gate_spec.py asserting: (a) a synthetic over-shrinker (constant per car-season) fails the signal-preservation guard / does not PASS; (b) a synthetic model that genuinely lowers noise while preserving accuracy registers axis-beats; (c) the >=7/11 rule + tie handling behave as specified. Run pytest, iterate to green.

preconditions.statement: floor.py + holdout.py available as building blocks

postconditions.statement: test_gate_spec.py passes: over-shrinker fails guard, genuine improver beats, 7/11+tie rule correct

constraints: gate rule is FROZEN by launch order -- implement exactly, do not soften

m5-wrapup.title: Full suite green + no-evo-import + no-db-commit check + write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m5-wrapup.imperative: Run the full three-file test command from the handoff's Verification Commands. Run grep -r evo src/physics/weekend_state/ and confirm no evo import. Confirm git status shows no data/*.db staged/modified. Produce the reproduced-vs-624 11-axis side-by-side table. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/wave4-626/g1-implementer-result.md per the template, including all required sections (completed slice, files changed, exact test output, table, assumptions, stop conditions, out-of-scope observations, workflow feedback, map impact).

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written to the exact path

constraints: result file at exact commander-specified path
